0.original: Munifrid seeks a seasoned adventurer for an important task.

48.original: <hex:022B7EFF7C020825E1E93501FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B4C696D73614D616C6554657874E9350903FF0103020828E1E93601FF2002281CFF17474352616E6B47726964616E69614D616C6554657874E9360903FF0103020825E1E93701FF1D022819FF14474352616E6B556C6461684D616C6554657874E9370903FF010303> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, you are well known for your deeds as a soldier. On this day, however, I would call upon your broad experiences as an adventurer.

49.original: As for the situation at hand, it would seem that part of our patrol route has been claimed as territory by a fearsome zu nestling. Yet we cannot simply choose to circumvent the area, lest we risk providing an unobserved entry point for imperial scouts.

50.original: My men and I will gladly go toe-to-toe with any military opponent. But nothing in our training has prepared us to combat a foe which can soar through the ravines and swoop down upon us with impunity.

51.original: My comrade here almost lost his arm to such an attack, and I fear it is only a matter of time ere the creature makes a kill...unless you kill it first.

52.original: The nestling surveys its domain from a narrow pillar of rock to the northeast. Pray find this predator, and end the threat to our patrols.

53.original: We might take the thing down eventually, but too much of our own blood would stain those rock walls. For a monster-slayer of your caliber, however, I should hope it will prove no great challenge...

54.original: The nestling is slain, then? I knew I had chosen the right <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> for the job.

55.original: I am grateful you came along before any lives were lost to that monstrous bird. You have our thanks!
